data.one_liner: A wrapper for ListWheelScrollView that allows children to respond to tap events.
data.what_it_does: It wraps a Flutter ListWheelScrollView to enable onTap gesture events on individual list items. It provides callbacks for item taps, supports scrolling on click, and allows handling loop delegates.
use_when: You need a wheel-style scrolling list where individual items must be clickable.
You want to handle tap events on specific items inside a ListWheelScrollView.
avoid_when: You are not using a ListWheelScrollView.
You require complex touch interactions other than standard tap events.
strengths: Simple and lightweight wrapper for existing ListWheelScrollView widgets.
Supports item tap callbacks and automatic scrolling on click.
weaknesses: Limited in scope, only solves tap handling for ListWheelScrollView.
Not documented with extensive custom gestures beyond standard taps.
